name: Feeds
tagline: Follow RSS feeds and listen to internet radio in one app
description:
Feeds is an Android app for following RSS and Atom feeds, with a few extra tricks: it can also play internet radio and IPTV streams, and add a home screen widget so your latest headlines are visible at a glance.

It's a lightweight, do-it-yourself style app for anyone who wants their feeds, radio, and playlists handled by one simple tool.
